We propose RDF (Robust Dual Fusion): MAD-standardized judge/fan z-scores fused with a tunable weight α; at α=0.5 it reproduces 81.8% of eliminations with a stable plateau over α ∈[0.2, 0.8], and—critically— makes the judge-fan balance an explicit, transparent dial instead of an opaque rule switch.
